name: kuber
description: Kuber — digital banking platform (automated dev runner)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix Backend && npm run lint --prefix Frontend
